meta.title: TimeSyncher Vacation: hard-coded content inventory (removal checklist)
meta.rule: Craig 13:01 HST: eliminate ALL hard-coded dialog and content. Live search = Brave + Tavily. DB of prior Things allowed, not as the only source. No Google Places.
meta.verdict: NOT compliant with Craig's rule. The product still ships seeded Big Island and Las Vegas place lists, invented Things (SpeediShuttle, Kona arrival), trip-specific reply rules and keyword-driven intake. Live search is not wired into the app, Brave is fallback-only and unreachable from the worker path, and Tavily does not exist in the code. This is an inventory, not a certification.

search_wiring.worker: Every customer turn inserts a worker_jobs 'trip_intake' row (routes/vacation-itinerary.mjs:456; also vacation-request.mjs:146, vacation-telegram-turn.mjs:1681). The off-box worker (manifest runtime /home/timesyncher-agent/timestopper-vacation-worker/…) runs scripts/product-gbrain-dispatch.mjs → runPublicResearch. Results go back through routes/worker-jobs.mjs persistArtifacts into trip_things.
search_wiring.research_chain: runPublicResearch: fixture (if env set) → house-radius POI (FSQ records passed in as an array, default [] → OSM Overpass → Brave only if fewer than 3 results) → Perplexity (PERPLEXITY_API_KEY and TIMESYNCHER_PUBLIC_RESEARCH_LIVE=1) → Grok CLI from PATH or TIMESYNCHER_GROK_BIN → travel-source adapters (Google Places adapter disabled; one fixture sentiment adapter).
search_wiring.blocker: product-gbrain-dispatch.mjs:1925 passes artifacts with no house/lodging coordinates, so runHousePoiResearch returns null (worker:424-427). FSQ/OSM/Brave never run on the dispatcher path.
search_wiring.brave: Code present: fetchBrave → api.search.brave.com/res/v1/web/search with X-Subscription-Token (poi-search.mjs:148-161), 8-hour cache, query '<category> near lat,lng'. Key read from BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY or BRAVE_API_KEY (worker:428). No .env/vercel config in the repo defines it; whether the off-box worker has the key is unknown (not visible from here).
search_wiring.tavily: 0 references anywhere at 128c9e1 (code, config, docs, tests) and 0 on main.
search_wiring.google_places: Removed: the adapter reports disabled_google_places_seed_removed; sourcedRatings drops google-places rows. No live Google Places calls found in product code.
search_wiring.plug_in: Put Brave + Tavily calls in the worker's trip_intake job: geocode the lodging or destination, query per wanted Thing and category, merge with the DB of prior Things, write to trip_things. Then delete padKeepsakeSharedPlaces, BIG_ISLAND_*, KEEPSAKE_* and the SpeediShuttle/Kona-arrival injection so the app reads only trip_things.

items.quote: runPublicResearch({ artifacts: { requestText, vacationName, unforgettableGoal, destination, dates, lodgingLane: lane } ...})
items.customer_effect: The worker passes no house/lodging coordinates, and runHousePoiResearch (worker:424-427) returns null without an origin. So FSQ/OSM/Brave never run on this path; it falls to Perplexity, then the Grok CLI.
items.replacement: Geocode the lodging/destination first, then run Brave/Tavily search

items.quote: const braveKey = input.braveKey ?? (process.env.BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY || process.env.BRAVE_API_KEY || ''); ... if (database.length >= thinAt || !braveKey ...) return [];
items.customer_effect: Brave is a fallback only: it runs when FSQ+OSM return fewer than 3 places and a key is set. The query is just '<category> near lat,lng'.
items.replacement: Make Brave (and Tavily) a primary source with customer-intent queries; DB of prior Things as a supplement

items.quote: git grep -i tavily 128c9e1 → 0 hits (code, config, docs)
items.customer_effect: Tavily is not referenced anywhere. No client, no key name, no config.
items.replacement: Add a Tavily client next to fetchBrave in poi-search.mjs plus a TAVILY_API_KEY env var

items.quote: restaurant 15 / store 10 / rest 15
items.customer_effect: Minimum counts drive the padding. The worker fails closed if it doesn't reach them, but the app pads with seeded names instead.
items.replacement: Keep minimums as a search target; never pad with fixed names

items.quote: add('Kona/Big Island', /\bkona\b|\bbig island\b/); add('Las Vegas', /\blas vegas\b|\bvegas\b/); ...
items.customer_effect: The worker's destination detection is a fixed list (Idaho, Oahu, Maui, Kona, Hawaii, Las Vegas).
items.replacement: Model-generated from the chat destination extraction

items.quote: insert into worker_jobs (...) values (..., 'trip_intake', ...) / insert into trip_things (...)
items.customer_effect: The plug-in point: every turn queues a trip_intake job, and the off-box worker's results land in trip_things. The worker runtime at /home/timesyncher-agent/... is not in the repo.
items.replacement: Put Brave/Tavily search in this worker job; the app reads trip_things only

items.quote: if (input.mode === 'fixture' || input.fixturePath || process.env.TIMESYNCHER_PUBLIC_RESEARCH_FIXTURE) { ... fixture.candidates }
items.customer_effect: One env var switches production research to a fixture file (scripts/public-research-fixture.json).
items.replacement: Remove fixture mode from the production path (tests only)

items.quote: const grokBin = process.env.TIMESYNCHER_GROK_BIN || 'grok';
